create_roberta_prelayernorm_config: create a RobertaPreLayerNormConfig instance with default transformer model settings
initialize_roberta_model: initialize a RobertaPreLayerNormModel with a RobertaPreLayerNormConfig configuration object
access_model_config: access the model configuration from a RobertaPreLayerNormModel instance via the config attribute
customize_roberta_config: customize RobertaPreLayerNormConfig parameters like vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
configure_roberta_embeddings: configure RobertaPreLayerNormConfig with custom max_position_embeddings, layer_norm_eps, and initializer_range values
